title:
Transforms an instance of {@link SensorHealthAlert} to achieve the following:
   - When a sensor in {@link SensorOperationalStatusEnum#FAULTY} status has an existing {@link SensorOperationalStatusTimedValue#endDate},
     a new `endDateWithPrefix` field is created by concatenating the locally formatted date with a translated prefix.
   - If there is any {@link Sensor} without an {@link Sensor#operationalStatus}, add a default value so that they are treated as
     {@link SensorOperationalStatusEnum#OPERATIONAL} in the UI.
   - Creates a new `valueIconMap` field to assign the appropriate icon to the sensor's {@link SensorOperationalStatusTimedValue#status}.
     This assignment is based on its translation field {@link SensorOperationalStatusTimedValue#translatedStatus}.
     Example:
       For a sensor in operational status (in English): { Operational: 'check-circle' }
       For a sensor in faulty status (in English): { Faulty: 'exclamation-triangle' }
name: TransformSensorHealthAlertOperationalStatus
